description: This file defines the GrainBasedPubSubRuntime class, which implements the IStreamPubSub interface for managing pub/sub interactions within Orleans streaming. It includes methods for registering/unregistering producers and consumers, counting them, retrieving subscriptions, and handling faulted subscriptions, utilizing Orleans grains.

classes.name: GrainBasedPubSubRuntime
classes.description: Implements IStreamPubSub for managing pub/sub operations in Orleans streaming, using grains for coordination.

methods.name: RegisterProducer
methods.description: Registers a producer for a specific stream.

methods.name: UnregisterProducer
methods.description: Unregisters a producer from a specific stream.

methods.name: RegisterConsumer
methods.description: Registers a consumer with a subscription ID for a specific stream.

methods.name: UnregisterConsumer
methods.description: Unregisters a consumer from a specific stream.

methods.name: ProducerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of producers for a stream.

methods.name: ConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of consumers for a stream.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a stream, optionally filtered by consumer.

methods.name: CreateSubscriptionId
methods.description: Creates a new subscription ID for a stream and consumer.
